title: SkillDuet: Co-Evolving Models and Skills through Response Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.12109v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: During reinforcement learning, experience can be both internalized in LLM parameters and retained externally as reusable textual skills. Parameter updates alter the model's behavior and the interaction experience from which new skills are extracted. These skills, in turn, guide the model's subsequent interactions and parameter updates. As the model's capabilities evolve, previously beneficial skills may become redundant or detrimental. We present SkillDuet, a framework that coordinates parameter updates and skill evolution through model response feedback. Skills extracted from on-policy trajectories guide parameter updates through OPD at every step. A response-based score, Strength, ranks candidate skills by the magnitude of the shift they induce in the current model's responses, and the highest-scoring skills are periodically consolidated into a persistent global skill set (Global). translated_title: SkillDuet：通过响应反馈实现模型与技能的协同演化
translated_abstract: 在强化学习过程中，经验既可以内化到大型语言模型的参数中，也可以作为可复用的文本技能在外部保留。参数更新会改变模型的行为及其交互经验，而新的技能正是从这些交互经验中提取出来的；这些技能反过来又会引导模型后续的交互和参数更新。随着模型能力的不断演进，先前有益的技能可能变得冗余甚至有害。我们提出了SkillDuet，一个通过模型响应反馈来协调参数更新与技能演化的框架。从同策略轨迹中提取的技能在每一步都通过OPD（同策略蒸馏）引导参数更新。一种基于响应的评分指标——Strength（强度），根据候选技能对当前模型响应所产生的偏移幅度对其进行排序，得分最高的技能会被定期整合到一个持久化的全局技能集（Global）中。更新后的模型与Global共同引导后续的训练过程。
tldr: SkillDuet提出了一个通过模型响应反馈协同演化LLM参数与外部文本技能的框架，利用技能引起的响应偏移幅度（Strength）进行评分，并定期将高分技能整合进持久化的全局技能集，使技能随模型能力演进保持有效。
en_tdlr: SkillDuet is a framework that co-evolves LLM parameters and reusable textual skills through response feedback, ranking candidate skills by the response shifts they induce and periodically consolidating the highest-scoring ones into a persistent global skill set.
